Forest plot of protein effect sizes and confidence intervals

Source: R/plot_omics_extra.R
plot_forest.Rd

Draws a horizontal forest plot of per-protein estimates and 95 intervals, optionally grouped by cohort, contrast, or significance. Accepts either explicit `lower_col`/`upper_col` bounds or a standard-error column (`se_col`), computing Wald intervals automatically.

Usage

plot_forest(
  data,
  assay_col = "Assay",
  estimate_col = "estimate",
  lower_col = NULL,
  upper_col = NULL,
  se_col = NULL,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  group = NULL,
  sig_col = NULL,
  top_n = NULL,
  order_by_effect = TRUE,
  ref = 0,
  palette = "okabe_ito",
  xlab = "Effect size (95% CI)",
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame with one row per protein (or protein x group).

assay_col

Name of the protein/label column (default `"Assay"`).

estimate_col

Name of the effect-size column (default `"estimate"`).

lower_col, upper_col

Optional column names for the lower and upper CI bounds. If omitted, `se_col` is used to compute `estimate +/- z * se`.

se_col

Optional standard-error column used when `lower_col` and `upper_col` are `NULL`.

conf_level

Confidence level for Wald intervals when `se_col` is used (default `0.95`).

group

Optional grouping column name for colour (e.g. cohort or panel).

sig_col

Optional logical column name distinguishing filled (TRUE) vs open (FALSE) points.

top_n

Optional integer: keep only the top `top_n` rows ranked by `abs(estimate)` when `data` is large.

order_by_effect

Logical; sort assays by effect size (default `TRUE`).

ref

Reference vertical line (default `0`).

palette

Optional colour palette name or vector when `group` is used.

xlab

x-axis label (default `"Effect size (95% CI)"`).

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A `ggplot` object.

Examples

plot_forest(bansal_univariate, assay_col = "Assay", estimate_col = "estimate",
            lower_col = "conf.low", upper_col = "conf.high", top_n = 15)
